text: Current LiveView notification callbacks create AutoJSAPI in PrivilegedJunkScope, obtain the active context and root the new message object before calling the listener. The historical notification landing stored a raw JSContext; that detail is no longer accepted source. Follow the current callback boundary when extending native notifications. This static reading does not prove garbage-collection safety of every caller. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Recreate a JavaScript context at each native notification
